generated_query:
I have a Cosmos DB container named `inventory` with a partition key of `/category`. I need to bulk-import the following new products (all in the "electronics" category) into the container, using the most efficient method possible. Could you write the TypeScript code using the Azure Cosmos DB SDK to perform a bulk create operation, then query the container to verify that all items were inserted correctly, and finally output the count of inserted items?

New products:
```json
[
  { "id": "e101", "category": "electronics", "name": "Wireless Mouse", "price": 29.99, "stock": 150 },
  { "id": "e102", "category": "electronics", "name": "USB-C Hub", "price": 49.99, "stock": 80 },
  { "id": "e103", "category": "electronics", "name": "27-inch Monitor", "price": 299.99, "stock": 25 }
]
```
